}

$weak = WeakReference::create($target);

$runner = new Fiber($pair);

    echo 'W', (int)($level === 8192), (int)(Fiber::getCurrent() === $GLOBALS['runner']), '|';
    echo 'R', Fiber::suspend('P'), '|';
    return true;
});
echo $runner->start(callback: [RawArrayCtorChild::class, 'RawArrayCtorBase::callback']), '|';
try { $runner->resume(9); }
catch (FiberError $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), '|';
    foreach ($error->getTrace() as $frame) {
        echo $frame['function'], '.', (int)isset($frame['file']), (int)isset($frame['line']), '|';

restore_error_handler();
echo (int)$runner->isTerminated(), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null);

Resuming authentic parser continuation rejects repeated construction, with real root/API traces; neither callback body executes and no failed return is read.

class RawCoreIdleCollector {

    function __construct() { $this->self = $this; }

        $GLOBALS['worker'] = Fiber::getCurrent();
        echo 'D|';

$request = new Fiber(static function () {
    $cycle = new RawCoreIdleCollector();
    unset($cycle);
    echo gc_collect_cycles(), '|';
});
$request->start();
unset($request);
$resume = new Fiber([$worker, 'resume']);
$throw = new Fiber([$worker, 'throw']);
$suspended = new Fiber([$worker, 'isSuspended']);
unset($worker);
echo (int)($resume->start(value: 123) === null), '|';
try { $throw->start(exception: new Exception('idle')); }
catch (Exception $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
